crop_method: Streamed source LAS in 1,000,000-point chunks. Reprojected official 2026 FID 411 WGS84 ring to EPSG:2968; retained all points inside the footprint and an exterior 5 m buffer. No class filter applied.
ground_reference_method: Class 2 ground returns in the 5 m exterior buffer; statistical baseline only, not a surveyed local grade datum.
interpretation: Returns are unclassified (class 1) rather than semantic building class 6. High returns over the mapped building outline coincide with the roof zone in the 2023 orthophoto, but can include equipment/parapet/tree-edge returns; their quantiles constrain the roof/top surface and do not directly measure wall eave height.
gps_time_convention: LAS global_encoding.gps_time_type=1, adjusted standard GPS time; UTC conversion used GPS epoch 1980-01-06 + 1,000,000,000 seconds + stored GPS time - 18 s GPS-UTC leap offset for 2018-04-20.
source_classification_note: Tile crop has only ASPRS classes 1 (unclassified), 2 (ground), and 7 (low vegetation); class 6 building returns are absent. Roof/top-surface interpretation is spatially supported by the official FID ring and 2023 orthophoto but not semantically classed.
source_delivery_quality: Indiana 2016-2020 QL2 product; statewide documentation reports 2 pulses/m2 and RMSEz <=0.100m, 95th-percentile NVA <=0.196m and VVA <=0.300m; no Bailey-specific accuracy assessment was performed.
